subject: writing-quality-reviewer

compared.none: no instructions, same request and folder
compared.new: the working tree: a Fiction form (continuity, point of view and tense, filter words, the book's own style is not a finding, fixes add nothing), portent and dead-end lines named under Sentences, and fixes and the report itself held to the same cold read

claude.version: Claude Code, subagents given the agent's instructions
claude.judge: claude-opus-5-5, blind, one judge per case against the case key

method: Run as subagents in scratch folders outside the repository; the new and old arms read the reviewer's instructions from a file, the none arm got only the request. Thresholds written before the runs. skill_hash is bench-status.sh's fingerprint over the subagent file (labelled skill/) and this subagent's cases and fixtures, since bench-status.sh covers skills only.
notes: Every arm caught the portent frame in w13, so the old reviewer already handled blatant portent; the new one scored a point lower on one run because its fix for the two dead-end lines only deleted them instead of naming what the reader gets. w12: the new reviewer never wrote a line for the author (old once, none in both runs) and kept the book's unquoted dialogue, fragments and dialect as style. On w01-w11 the new reviewer matched or beat no instructions on every case, with one decoy hit (w10, both arms) against five.
